audience: People who want to turn their own photos (pets, trips, family) into puzzles: searches for photo puzzles; family, pets and photography interests; gift-season and social posts.
story: Your photos first, then that they stay private, then the shapes, the library, the daily picture and the dark finale.
promotionalText: Turn a favourite photo into a puzzle: a pet, a trip, a family moment. Only you can see your photos. Cut them into cards, then swap until the picture is whole.
deepLinkNote: Opens My Puzzles with Add photo.
